preview_gate.bootstrap: uv pip install --system -r tests/e2e/requirements.txt && playwright install chromium
preview_gate.run: bash tools/smoke_test.sh "$INFRA2_HOOK_APP_URL" && python tools/test_selection.py --stage preview_minimum_e2e --run && python tools/test_selection.py --touched-files ${INFRA2_TOUCHED_FILES:-} --run

staging_gate.bootstrap: uv pip install --system -r tests/e2e/requirements.txt && playwright install chromium
staging_gate.run: bash tools/smoke_test.sh "$INFRA2_HOOK_APP_URL" && python tools/test_selection.py --stage staging_core_e2e --run && STRICT_E2E_GATES=1 python -m pytest tests/e2e/test_ai_provider_connectivity.py -v --tb=short -o addopts="" && python tools/test_selection.py --stage staging_ai_ocr --corpus canary --run

scheduled_audit.bootstrap: uv pip install --system -r tests/e2e/requirements.txt && playwright install chromium
scheduled_audit.run: python tools/test_selection.py --stage staging_ai_ocr --corpus audit_replay --run && python tools/test_selection.py --stage staging_ai_ocr --corpus core_journey --run && python -m common.testing.benchmarks.pdf_corpus_oracle --app-url "$INFRA2_HOOK_APP_URL" --max-workers 1 && python -m common.testing.benchmarks.run_financial_scenario_benchmark --app-url "$INFRA2_HOOK_APP_URL" --case 1,2,3,4,5,6
